title: "Software & Data"
description: "Entry point to scientific software and curated external marine data sources."

This route brings together the two reusable technical layers of the website: scientific software and external data discovery.

## Software

The [Software catalogue](/software/) documents scientific packages, applications, and concepts with explicit maturity and canonical repository links. Repositories remain the source of truth for code, documentation, releases, and issues.

## Data Sources

[Data Sources](/data/) is a curated directory of external biological, fisheries, acoustic, oceanographic, satellite, climate, and geospatial resources. The site does not mirror or claim ownership of those source datasets.

## Reproducible workflows

The [Reproducible marine data systems](/projects/reproducible-marine-data-systems/) project describes the broader connection between acquisition, quality control, harmonization, modelling, visualization, and reporting.
